title: Setlist Share
description: A share-card generator for your top songs. Pick a song and the card composes itself: the background wipes in with the colour lifted from the cover, the cover drops into place, the title rises word by word and a pull-quote types itself out. Copy image renders the card to a PNG on a canvas and it flies into the button.
intent: A real share flow: colour from the artwork, a composed card that animates element by element, and a pixel-faithful canvas export to the clipboard with a download fallback.
